protocol.computation: Local public graph/context, analytic commitment risk, and action inventory only; no search, sampling, or performance replay.
protocol.menu: Full common committed public menu, lookahead 1500 seconds, including WAIT; no outcome-based filtering.
protocol.boundary: Both next action return and first downstream transfer, conditioned only on existing incumbent ride receipts.
protocol.interpretation: U minus clairvoyant point/lower is certificate slack; it is not true causal regret. Improved witness gains are established separately.
